Definition: Uriel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Uriel stands in the Levite line as the son of Tahath. Uriel of Gibeah is the father of Michaiah, the mother of King Abijah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the record names fathers and grandfathers because God works through lines: one Uriel sings in the Levite choir and the other stands behind a king's mother, and neither is named by accident.
RelatedPeople: Uriel, Son of Tahath; Uriel, of Gibeah
